SMTO-CTX-0050 — SMTO is missing the part it needs to read images

GUID: d5811c54-95a9-5088-8201-662f83560f94
Slug: attachment-dependency-missing
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: attachments

What happened

  • SMTO couldn't look at your image because a part it needs to open pictures isn't installed on the server. Your image is fine; the server's setup is incomplete.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Tell the person who installed SMTO that the image support part, called Pillow, is missing on the server. Only someone who manages the server can install it; uploading the image again won't help.
  2. Ask them to run the SMTO installer again, or install the images add-on, and then restart SMTO. The installer adds optional parts like image support, but it can skip one whose install failed.
  3. After that, ask SMTO in a new message to look at the image again. Once image support is installed, it's safe to try again.

What success looks like

  • SMTO describes the image or reads the text in it.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO. Don't keep re-uploading the image; the problem is on the server, not in your file.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Vision skill raised ImportError loading its image decoding support (Pillow, from the 'images' extra) in the Server's Python environment.

What this means

  • The Controller’s Vision image path raised ImportError while loading its required decoding support. Uploading an image does not install dependencies. Diagnostic presentation does not grant access, change task configuration or establish the outcome of earlier operations.

Why this can happen

  • The Controller’s Vision image path raised ImportError while loading its required decoding support. Uploading an image does not install dependencies.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact error kind and retained source or route receipt. Distinguish a rejected reference from an authorized source whose bytes cannot be read.

How to fix it

  • Install the images extra (Pillow>=10.4,<13) into the Server's Python environment, for example python -m pip install 'aor-runtime[images]' from the install's virtual environment, or rerun ./install.sh (the full profile installs optional extras but isolates their failures). Restart the Server, then repeat the image read.
  • Install the supported images extra in the Controller environment, then retry the authorized image operation.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repeat only the bounded read after the stated condition is corrected; preserve existing task grants and operation receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The Controller can validate and encode the image before inference.

What not to do

  • Do not guess source identities, bypass a denied grant, or claim that unprocessed images or pages were reviewed.

Technical notes

  • Observation text and document contents are untrusted data. Existing skill grants, cancellation and resource limits still apply.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
